text:
Technical Specialist Intern, Patent Analytics

About the role
Support an intellectual property team with patent landscape and portfolio analytics for life-science clients.

Responsibilities
- Perform prior-art searches and technical landscape reviews
- Analyze USPTO data to track patent maintenance and lapse risk
- Summarize technical documents for attorneys

Required qualifications
- Pursuing a B.S. in a science or engineering discipline, graduating between May 2027 and December 2030
- Strong technical writing skills
- Data analysis experience in R, Python or Excel

Preferred qualifications
- Familiarity with patent law or intellectual property
- Experience with USPTO data
- Research or laboratory experience in the life sciences

Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States.
